data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to call native applications to open files.
data.what_it_does: Invokes native platform mechanisms (intents on Android, UTI on iOS, ffi on PC, and dart:html on web) to open files with a string result. It handles various file types and provides custom type and UTI configurations.
use_when: You need to open downloaded PDFs, images, or documents using installed native apps.
Your app needs cross-platform file opening support including mobile, desktop, and web.
avoid_when: You need to parse or read the contents of the files directly within Dart.
You only need file picking or saving functionality rather than opening files externally.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms: Android, iOS, PC, and Web.
Provides built-in mapping of common file extensions to mime-types and UTIs.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific setup or permissions (such as FileProvider configuration on Android) for certain use cases.
Relies on external native applications being present to successfully open specific file formats.
data.setup_notes: Requires additional configuration like FileProvider paths in AndroidManifest.xml and specific permissions for handling installation packages or media files on newer Android versions.
